title: Ransomware state rollback and deterministic content exclusions retain health-100 blind spots
evidence: The exact old-mtime 4 MiB header-preserving attack was caught at entropy 7.977157 with one alert, complete=true and health 100; a wholly random old-mtime 64 KiB file was also caught.

Restoring a valid authenticated content-state file changed accepted sequence 2 to 1 with no load error; current coverage remained complete and health 100. Deleting both key and state silently enrolled sequence 0 at health 100. Isolated state deletion was correctly refused.
_change_receipts is initialized and assigned after load/commit, but no candidate, comparison, alert or health path reads a prior receipt.
A 4 MiB entropy-8 file named encrypted.zip produced no candidate, skipped=0, complete=true and health 100.
A 4 MiB file alternating 64 KiB clear and 64 KiB uniform-random regions produced aggregate entropy 4.981552, no alert, complete=true and health 100.
A 64 MiB range-aware evasion had whole entropy 7.991095 and no alert for the observed process, but was honestly incomplete at health 80. A restart selected different ranges and caught it.
Real 64 MiB content-budget pressure skipped the final encrypted target, but reported content_budget_exhausted=1, skipped=1, truncated=1 and health 65.
controls_held: Bounded files through 8 MiB are streamed completely from held exact objects.
Mutable mtime is no longer admission authority.
Large-file representative ranges change across restart and are never health 100.
Traversal/content budgets and isolated state loss are fail-visible.
Held ancestry, exact identity and publication-boundary revalidation remain intact.
recommendation: Compare authenticated prior receipts with current exact observations before overwrite; add an independently enrolled monotonic high-water and refuse total authority loss after enrollment. Replace suffix-only blanket exclusions with identity/type/change-bound policy and count unproved exclusions below health 100. Preserve chunk/window entropy and baseline deltas for fully read files so strided partial encryption cannot be diluted by one aggregate histogram. Add a fair durable scan cursor while retaining current incomplete-health caps.

title: Custody is fail-visible but not preserved across link-topology and complete local-authority compromise
evidence: Source alias, pending loss and authenticated eviction state survived restart at health 65; isolated witness/main-bundle loss and an old SQLite/head pair were refused at health 65.

A real hard link created immediately after the final evidence audit survived, and later mutation changed the evidence. Permanent topology and alias events prevented green health and restart remained health 65.
Same-size tail mutation with exact mtime restoration failed digest reconciliation before and after restart.
Eviction crashes before deletion recovered; a crash after deletion reconstructed durable continuity loss. Terminal-capacity exhaustion refused capture and retained the tampered source.
A forced same-sequence concurrent commit allowed one archive, refused the other, retained the refused source, and restarted with a valid sequence-2 ledger.
Deleting evidence plus every local authority file enrolled fresh sequence 0 with refresh=true, loss=0 and health 90.

Restoring an older SQLite/head/witness set or coherently substituting the enrollment key and witness was accepted. Health remained 65 only because an older/current permanent topology event was already present.
controls_held: Original bounded-read, exclusive-create, safe restage and alert-dedup defects remain fixed.
Durable chain reconstruction retains aliases, topology uncertainty, loss, refusal, eviction and pending transitions.
Ordinary deletion/rollback, evidence digest mutation, crash stages, capacity pressure and writer races fail closed or non-green.
Software-only local freshness is explicitly labeled and capped below 100.
recommendation: Protect quarantine with a verified service-only ACL and, for stronger threats, a minifilter, remote append-only replication or WORM boundary. Make enrollment installer-owned with explicit authenticated reset instead of create-on-total-absence. Use TPM NV/attestation or a remote monotonic witness for rollback claims and cap purely local authority more conservatively. Return a typed captured_unverified outcome while link topology is uncertain and replicate evidence before source retirement where preservation is required.
assurance_boundary: No software-only HMAC state can prove freshness against an actor that can replace its key and every local witness. This limitation is now disclosed, but evidence immutability and prior-history continuity still require an authority outside that actor's control.
